menu:9006990:2.text: Grilled fish! Do you have one for me?

say:1:1434802001:1.text: I'm so hungry... I can't even think...
say:1:1434802001:1.male: I'm so hungry... I can't even think...
say:1:1434802001:1.female: I'm so hungry... I can't even think...

say:2:1434802002:1.text: Ah, if it isn't the legendary Merlin of the treasure-hunting hamster world! Sorry, I'm not in the mood for digging up treasure today.
say:2:1434802002:1.source_cn: 啊，这不是我们寻宝仓鼠界赫赫有名的梅林大人吗？抱歉，现...

say:4:1434802003:1.text: You think I'm going to say it's because I'm too hungry? Ha! Wrong! It's because I just don't feel like working!
say:4:1434802003:1.source_cn: 因为我太饿了——以为我会这么说吗？不！因为我不想工作！

say:6:1434802004:1.text: Of course! This is my firm and glorious stance—no amount of guilt-tripping will make me budge!
say:6:1434802004:1.source_cn: 当然，这是我坚定不移的立场，绝对不会因为饥饿而改变！
say:6:1434802004:1.male: Of course! This is my firm and glorious stance—no amount of guilt-tripping will make me budge!
say:6:1434802004:1.female: Of course! This is my firm and glorious stance—no amount of guilt-tripping will make me budge!

say:7:1434802006:1.text: That said... I haven't eaten in three days. Even if I wanted to hunt for treasure again, I've got no strength left...
say:7:1434802006:1.source_cn: 而且，就算现在我想改变立场重新开始伟大的寻宝工作，但我...
say:7:1434802006:1.male: That said... I haven't eaten in three days. Even if I wanted to hunt for treasure again, I've got no strength left...
say:7:1434802006:1.female: That said... I haven't eaten in three days. Even if I wanted to hunt for treasure again, I've got no strength left...

say:8:1434802007:1.text: So please, Great Magister, I beg you. Feed me!
say:8:1434802007:1.source_cn: 所以，拜托了，魔法师大人，我好饿，求你给我找点吃的吧……
say:8:1434802007:1.male: So please, Great Magister, I beg you. Feed me!
say:8:1434802007:1.female: So please, Great Magister, I beg you. Feed me!

say:9:1434802008:1.text: But no more nuts. I'm sick of nuts. Bring me a fish. Cooked, not raw! Preferably a <style="highlight">grilled ironfin trout</style>! Well done, even slightly charred.
say:9:1434802008:1.source_cn: 对了，我已经吃腻坚果了，麻烦你给我找条鱼来，不要钓上来...
say:9:1434802008:1.male: But no more nuts. I'm sick of nuts. Bring me a fish. Cooked, not raw! Preferably a <style="highlight">grilled ironfin trout</style>! Well done, even slightly charred.
say:9:1434802008:1.female: But no more nuts. I'm sick of nuts. Bring me a fish. Cooked, not raw! Preferably a <style="highlight">grilled ironfin trout</style>! Well done, even slightly charred.

choice_prompt:10:1434802008.male: But no more nuts. I'm sick of nuts. Bring me a fish. Cooked, not raw! Preferably a <style="highlight">grilled ironfin trout</style>! Well done, even slightly charred.

say:11:1434802009:1.text: Please, Magister! Would you really let an innocent, starving hamster waste away before your very eyes?
say:11:1434802009:1.source_cn: 求你了，梅林大人，你难道愿意眼睁睁地看着一只无辜的小仓...
say:11:1434802009:1.male: Please, Magister! Would you really let an innocent, starving hamster waste away before your very eyes?
say:11:1434802009:1.female: Please, Magister! Would you really let an innocent, starving hamster waste away before your very eyes?

say:12:1434802010:1.text: You're a legend in the treasure hamster world—no, the entire hamster world! Everyone says you're a true hamster friend!
say:12:1434802010:1.source_cn: 你可是我们寻宝仓鼠界，不，整个仓鼠界都知名的仓鼠爱好者...

choice:5:0:1.text: Wow. Bold of you to admit.
choice:5:0:1.male: Wow. Bold of you to admit.
choice:5:0:1.female: Wow. Bold of you to admit.

say:16:1434802005:1.text: Pfft. Do I look like the kind of hamster who'd give up his principles over something as petty as hunger?
say:16:1434802005:1.source_cn: 我是那种会因为一点道德指控就放弃自己立场的仓鼠吗？！
say:16:1434802005:1.male: Pfft. Do I look like the kind of hamster who'd give up his principles over something as petty as hunger?
say:16:1434802005:1.female: Pfft. Do I look like the kind of hamster who'd give up his principles over something as petty as hunger?

say:1:1434803001:1.text: I smell grilled fish! Is it ironfish trout? Please tell me it's crispy!
say:1:1434803001:1.source_cn: 我闻到了烤鱼的香味！是铁鳍鳟鱼吗？而且烤得焦焦脆脆的！

say:3:1434803002:1.text: His eyes sparkle as he chomps it down—bones and all!
say:3:1434803002:1.source_cn: 接过烤鱼的不寻宝仓鼠两眼一亮，狼吞虎咽地把鱼吃了个精光...
say:3:1434803002:1.male: His eyes sparkle as he chomps it down—bones and all!
say:3:1434803002:1.female: His eyes sparkle as he chomps it down—bones and all!

say:4:1434803003:1.text: Mmm! So good! I haven't eaten this well in days...
say:4:1434803003:1.source_cn: 好吃！美味！吃得好饱……已经好几天没吃这么饱了……
say:4:1434803003:1.male: Mmm! So good! I haven't eaten this well in days...
say:4:1434803003:1.female: Mmm! So good! I haven't eaten this well in days...

say:6:1434803004:1.text: Huh? What? No, no. There's something even more important...
say:6:1434803004:1.source_cn: 现在可不是想这个的时候！有更重要的事要做！
say:6:1434803004:1.male: Huh? What? No, no. There's something even more important...
say:6:1434803004:1.female: Huh? What? No, no. There's something even more important...

say:7:1434803006:1.text: You can't sleep when you're starving, you know?
say:7:1434803006:1.source_cn: 呵欠……梅林大人，您也知道……呵欠，一旦肚子饿，就会睡...
say:7:1434803006:1.male: You can't sleep when you're starving, you know?
say:7:1434803006:1.female: You can't sleep when you're starving, you know?

say:8:1434803007:1.text: But once you're full... *yawn* it hits you...
say:8:1434803007:1.source_cn: 一旦吃饱……呵欠，就会很想睡觉……
say:8:1434803007:1.male: But once you're full... *yawn* it hits you...
say:8:1434803007:1.female: But once you're full... *yawn* it hits you...

say:9:1434803008:1.text: This will be my first good nap in days... You wouldn't take that away from me, would you, Great Magister?
say:9:1434803008:1.source_cn: 这也是我这两天第一次……呵欠……睡个……好觉……您忍心...
say:9:1434803008:1.male: This will be my first good nap in days... You wouldn't take that away from me, would you, Great Magister?
say:9:1434803008:1.female: This will be my first good nap in days... You wouldn't take that away from me, would you, Great Magister?

choice_prompt:10:1434803008.text: This will be my first good nap in days... You wouldn't take that away from me, would you, Great Magister?
choice_prompt:10:1434803008.source_cn: 这也是我这两天第一次……呵欠……睡个……好觉……您忍心……呵欠！
choice_prompt:10:1434803008.male: This will be my first good nap in days... You wouldn't take that away from me, would you, Great Magister?

say:11:1434803009:1.text: Hehe! Thank you, oh merciful Magister Merlin!
say:11:1434803009:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，多谢梅林大人网开一面，我这就去休息了！
say:11:1434803009:1.male: Hehe! Thank you, oh merciful Magister Merlin!
say:11:1434803009:1.female: Hehe! Thank you, oh merciful Magister Merlin!

say:12:1434803010:1.text: You truly are the most beloved hamster friend in all the land!
say:12:1434803010:1.source_cn: 您不愧是我们寻宝仓鼠界，不，整个仓鼠界都知名的仓鼠爱好者！
say:12:1434803010:1.male: You truly are the most beloved hamster friend in all the land!
say:12:1434803010:1.female: You truly are the most beloved hamster friend in all the land!

say:13:1434803011:1.text: May your days be filled with tasty food, warm beds, and a life of joy, without any work!
say:13:1434803011:1.source_cn: 祝您吃好喝好睡好，每天开开心心，不用工作！
say:13:1434803011:1.male: May your days be filled with tasty food, warm beds, and a life of joy, without any work!
say:13:1434803011:1.female: May your days be filled with tasty food, warm beds, and a life of joy, without any work!

choice:5:0:1.text: Now that you're full, time to work!
choice:5:0:1.male: Now that you're full, time to work!
choice:5:0:1.female: Now that you're full, time to work!

say:15:1434803005:1.text: Because... *yawn* I haven't had a full belly in forever...
say:15:1434803005:1.source_cn: 因为……呵欠……好久没吃饱了……
say:15:1434803005:1.male: Because... *yawn* I haven't had a full belly in forever...
say:15:1434803005:1.female: Because... *yawn* I haven't had a full belly in forever...
